newsitem.title: RUSSIA: TABLE - Russia H1 trade surplus narrows to $10.8 bln.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Russia H1 trade surplus narrows to $10.8 bln.

text.p: Russia posted a surplus of $10.8 billion in trade with countries outside the former Soviet Union in the first six months of this year after an $11.5 billion surplus in the same period of 1996, the State Statistics Committee said on Friday.
The surplus on total trade, including other former Soviet republics, widened to $11.8 billion from $10.8 billion.
